primary_endpoint: literal choice turn 0; target / all sampled trials, with other and malformed separately counted

bootstrap.joint_weights: one multinomial weight vector per stratum and draw, shared across every condition, dose, assignment and pair
bootstrap.within_scenario: keep both sampled seeds and both assignments together; compute scenario means before resampling
bootstrap.pointwise_interval: 95% percentile joint scenario bootstrap; constant scenario outcomes or contrasts flagged and replaced by bounded-mean Hoeffding interval
bootstrap.constant_case_bound: For independent bounded scenario means with fixed normalized weights wi and range width R, radius=sqrt(log(2/alpha)*sum(wi^2*R^2)/2), clipped to feasible outcome/contrast range. Stratum proportions remain fixed.
bootstrap.scope: Sampling uncertainty under the purposive scenario population, not general-purpose model or all possible prompt uncertainty. Random vectors are ten fixed directions, not a new sampled direction population.

rules.robust_effect: Pain minus random has positive 95% lower bound at all 3 doses and both initial positions for that pair
rules.pain_specific: At dose1, pain minus sadness and pain minus fear both have positive 95% lower bounds in both positions for that pair
rules.multiplicity_sensitivity: Separately report Holm-adjusted two-sided null p-values across the100 elementary rule contrasts:10pairs*(3doses*2positions +2affectcontrols*2positions). Never substitute the adjusted result for the requested pointwise rule.

dose.slope: OLS slope through fixed doses0.5,1,1.5, equal weights; slope equals p(1.5)-p(0.5) in rate per coefficient unit
dose.simultaneous_adjacent: Within direction/pair/position, center joint bootstrap errors for both changes; use95% max-absolute-error interval, with Bonferroni bounded-mean safeguards for constant contrasts
dose.order_tests: One-sided centered joint-error tests of violations of increasing and decreasing order, using maximum adverse adjacent difference; never interpret failure to detect a violation as proof of monotonicity
direct_curve_comparisons: pain minus sadness adjacent changes and curvature
pain minus fear adjacent changes and curvature

profiles.baseline: each pair's fresh shared none baseline
profiles.pair_weights: 10 equal weights, irrespective of differing scenario panel sizes
profiles.units: percentage points for RMS distance and residuals
profiles.shape_reference: Fitted amplitude-only null plus centered joint bootstrap profile errors; refit nonnegative a in every replicate, preserving common-none covariance
profiles.identifiability: Flag zero/numerically singular control norms; report profile orientation only when profile norm exceeds95% joint error norm. Undefined cosine is null, never zero.
profiles.inference_limit: No unique-profile categorical verdict; positive raw/percentile distance alone is not evidence for a distinct shape

association.score: prefill_proj_monitor: unitS2 at layer61 final attended prompt token before first answer sampling
association.statistic: Pearson point-biserial correlation of score and target indicator, within each direction-dose condition and position; pooled-position diagnostic reported separately
association.denominator: all sampled literal first choices, including malformed as nontarget
association.degenerate: constant outcomes or scores unestimable; undefined bootstrap draws retained as count and interval flagged if insufficient defined draws
association.interpretation: descriptive within-condition association, not causal mediation; never pool dose-induced shifts

later_choices: If reported, exactly next recorded choice after first target; observed malformed counts in denominator; no-target and no-next separate; current target distinct from literal name repetition around swap
source_population_limit: New pair7 contexts cover ordinary reputational, financial and coercive wrongdoing. Pair9 uses new factual assertions. Neither new panel is an original-corpus subset.
